typography.headings: Cabinet Grotesk or Outfit for display tension. If bound to existing (e.g., Inter), apply tracking-tight for elegance.
typography.body: IBM Plex Sans or JetBrains Mono for developer/software house aesthetic. Keep text readable with balanced line-height.
typography.weights: Radical weight contrast (e.g., Light vs Black). Use font-medium for standard tech tags.
typography.rules: Avoid default Vercel-look. No center-aligned blocks for dense text; prioritize left-alignment.

colors.archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Authority, Clarity, Truth) mixed with ARCHETYPE 5: LUXURY
colors.surface: Crystal Glass (backdrop-blur-xl, saturate-150, 1px subtle border) for floating tech elements.

grids.settings_grid: grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(400px, 1fr)); gap: 2rem; align-items: start;

settings_page.instruction: Make settings layout full-width to resolve the 'half-screen' issue. In App.css, remove 'max-width: 750px' from '.settings-layout'. Apply 'width: 100%; max-width: 1200px; display: grid;' using the settings_grid defined above. This ensures panels utilize the full screen width gracefully.

login_page.instruction: Integrate software house & developer visual assets gracefully around the existing Barong Mascot. Use asymmetrical floating 'tech pills' behind or beside the mascot to convey tech-driven elegance without cluttering.

login_developer_assets.description: Floating pill. Text: '[200 OK] build: success'. Style: Monospace font, text-xs, glowing green dot, glassmorphism background (backdrop-blur-md, border-white/10). Use framer-motion for a gentle, slow float.
Floating pill. Text: '< / > API V2 Active'. Style: Monospace font, text-xs, glassmorphism background. Gentle float animation.
Floating pill. Text: 'git branch --main'. Include a small GitBranch lucide icon. Glassmorphism style.

clickup_removal.instruction: Remove the 'Impor ClickUp' Link element (<Link to='/imports/clickup'>...) from the bottom of the Settings component entirely.

motion.floating_tags: Use framer-motion for the login developer tags: animate={{ y: [0, -10, 0] }} transition={{ duration: 4, repeat: Infinity, ease: 'easeInOut' }} with staggered delays.

accessibility.focus_states: Must have HIGHER contrast than default state (e.g., focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-300).
accessibility.test_ids: Ensure new components like floating tags include 'aria-hidden="true"' as they are decorative. Remove 'data-testid="settings-clickup-import"' element.

media.images: Retain BarongMascot as is. Do not add heavy images; use clean CSS/Lucide icons for developer elements.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: 1. Prioritize pre-existing UI components from src/components/ui. 2. Do not use generic AI emojis. 3. Ensure 'data-testid' is added to all new interactive/informational elements. 4. Build depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy. 5. Maintain Barong interactions on the login page; the new tech tags should be purely decorative and elegant. 6. Address CSS strictly to remove max-width constraints on the Settings layout.
